CREATIVE ARTS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #13
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.
   B. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.

2. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Athletics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Athletics.
   C. Damage equipment used for Athletics.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Athletics.

3. Best practice when working on Photography: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Photography.
   B. Practise Photography with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Photography.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Photography.

   D. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Games.

5. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)

6. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)

   B. Guarantee a trophy
   C. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   D. Replace drinking water

7. Best practice when working on Swimming: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Swimming.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Swimming.
   C. Damage equipment used for Swimming.
   D. Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. Best practice when working on Painting and Montage: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Painting and Montage.
   B. Practise Painting and Montage with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Painting and Montage.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Painting and Montage.

9. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Red, blue, and yellow
   B. Black, white, and grey
   C. Brown, pink, and gold
   D. Green, orange, and purple

10. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   B. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   D. Damage equipment used for Melody.

11. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The speed of the music
   B. Only the costume
   C. The ticket price
   D. Only the volume

12. Best practice when working on Percussion Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Percussion Musical Instruments.
   B. Damage equipment used for Percussion Musical Instruments.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Percussion Musical Instruments.

13. Best practice when working on Gymnastics: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Gymnastics.
   B. Damage equipment used for Gymnastics.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Gymnastics.
   D. Practise Gymnastics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

14. Best practice when working on Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Songs.
   B. Practise Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Songs.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Songs.

15. Best practice when working on Netball: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Netball.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Netball.
   C. Practise Netball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Netball.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Painting and Montage and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Indigenous Kenyan Games and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
